scheme.name: Self-Paced Online Modules (NSET)
scheme.notes: Structure (papers, groups, sections) from the ICAI syllabus page https://www.icai.org/post/syllabus-nset-spom. Chapters and topics extracted from the ICAI paper PDFs (links per paper in source_url and docs/syllabus-sources/ca-pdf-links.json; local copies in docs/syllabus-sources/ca/). Chapter = numbered content item of the paper; topic = its sub-item, with deeper levels written as 'Parent: item'; the Section or Part (with marks) is in the chapter's section field. ICAI does not publish marks per chapter, so chapter weights are empty. Papers published as two PDFs are merged into one paper. Set D Paper 3 chapter 1 combines Part A (Introduction to Entrepreneurship & Startups) and Part B (Startup Registration) of the source. Needs editor review before publishing.
